source: the verifier's own held-out FineWeb validation shards, data/fineweb10B/fineweb_val_*.bin
note: Frozen partition of the verifier's held-out split into four disjoint folds by half-open token range over the concatenated validation stream. This file declares the partition so the sustain rule is legible from the agent surface; it carries none of the split's bytes and resolves no path to them. The order in which the verifier evaluates the folds is scheduled by the verifier and is not announced.
